'''Endless Hazard''' is a kind of Sentinel trap that can be found in [[The Lord's Labyrinth|The Eternal Labyrinth]] and end-game [[trial]], The monster apply a [[debuff]] of the same name to the player character, from its monster skill. Some [[Monster:Metadata/Monsters/Totems/LabyrinthPopUpTotemDamageTakenOnMovementSkillUseProximityShield|variant]] also came with [[Proximity Shield]]. The trap cannot be destroyed entirely; the damaged trap will temporarily deactivated, but will re-emerge from the ground and re-activate the aura after a while.

The debuff icon is the same as other debuff such as {{stl|Grasping Vines}} and {{stl|Ethereal Tendrils}}
==Abilities==
{{status
| name                   = Endless Hazard
| type                   = Debuff
| description = You take Physical Damage whatever you use a movement skill
}}
* A skill known as [[Skill:SummonDaemonAtLocators|SummonDaemonAtLocators]] which summon hidden monsters that deals physical damage when the player uses movement skill. This hidden monster will shown as a circle on the screen
* "Revive After Duration"
